TO PERSONS UNDER THE AGE OF EIGHTEEN YEARS PROHIBITED, OF
CHAPTER9.16, OFFENSES BY OR AGAINST MINORS, OFCHAPTER9,
PUBLIC PEACE AND WELFARE, OF THE CHEYENNE CITY CODE,
PERTAINING TO ELECTRONIC CIGARETTES."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section 1. That Section 9.16.070(A), Sale of tobacco to persons under the age of eighteen
years prohibited, of Chapter 9.16, Offenses By or Against Minors, of Title 9, Public Peace and
Welfare, of the Cheyenne City Code, pertaining to electronic cigarettes, ishereby amended toread
as follows:
9.16.070.
Sale of tobacco to persons under the age of eighteen years prohibited.
A.
As used in Sections 9.16.070 through 9.16.090:
1.
"Tobacco products"means any substance containing tobacco leaf, OR ANY
PRODUCT DERIVED FROM TOBACCO THAT CONTAINS NICOTINE, including, but
not limited to, cigarettes, ELECTRONIC CIGARETTES, cigars, pipe tobacco, snuff,
chewing tobacco or dipping tobacco;
2.
"Vending machine”means any mechanical, electric or electronic self-service
device which, upon insertion of money, tokens, or any other form of payment, dispenses
tobacco products; and
3.
“Retailer”means a business of any kind at a specific location that sells
tobacco products toauser or consumer; AND
4.
ANY MECHANICAL HEATING ELEMENT, BATTERY OR ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT,
REGARDLESS OF SHAPE OR SIZE, THAT CAN BE USED TO DELIVER DOSES OF
CONTAINED IN A CARTRIDGE OR OTHER DELIVERY SYSTEM.
Section 2.This ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon approval and publication.
